verify_detail: `pm clear` the app's data (or otherwise reset `launchCount`) before each run, each successive CI/local run lands on a different point in that 5-launch cycle, so the assertion passes or fails depending on run history rather than on any real defect.\n\n**Fix:** have the test clear app data (`pm clear dev.lincforge.benchtarget` or equivalent instrumentation reset) before each cold-start, or assert against a specific known `launchCount`/screen state instead of assuming the button is always present."
